module_responsibilities.summary: Detached truth from one completed Binance USD-M position response.
Detached portfolio proposal contracts; no runtime entry point.
R1: deterministic, proposal-only whole-book capital priority.
Read/verify/transform/bind only. Factory and allocator retain authority.
Deterministic exposure context; no statistical classification or trade authority.
DEC-02: inspectable comparison view over the single allocator authority.
Bounded current-source reader. No venue calls or trading-journal writes.
Versioned expected economics, detached from execution and decision authority.
Proposal-only replacement comparison. No production switching model exists.
Pure Stage-6 producer around unchanged opportunity-context.v1.
Reference-only SDD 15.7 registry. Exact occurrences, never inferred episodes.
Pure event gate over caller-delivered frozen cuts; no polling or scheduler.
Normal proposal-only runtime consumer with atomic durable checkpoints.
Independent current book measurements from trusted, frozen source readers.
Bounded read-only delivery of existing immutable Stage6 publications.
Detached AllocationProposal -> typed exposure/action for a future Risk consumer.
